alert_command.trigger: first aggro or authored level event

walk_start.trigger: AI chase begins and displacement succeeds

walk_stop.trigger: attack range reached or chase stops

baton_jab.trigger: close-range AI attack choice A with token

baton_backhand.trigger: close-range AI attack choice B with token

baton_overhead.trigger: telegraphed heavy AI choice with token

block.trigger: incoming attack windup inside guard range and block cooldown clear

down.trigger: fall completes with health above zero

rise.trigger: down timer expires with health above zero
